report_name: Ransomware Attack on Japan's Keio Corp Disrupts Retail, Hotels

threat_actors.name: Unknown Ransomware Group
threat_actors.description: The unidentified threat actor responsible for the ransomware attack against Keio Corporation, causing widespread disruption to its retail and hospitality businesses.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The core of the attack involved encrypting critical data and systems at Keio Corporation, such as payment processing and hotel management systems, making them inaccessible.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The attackers inhibited system recovery by deleting volume shadow copies and backup catalogs using tools like vssadmin.exe and wbadmin.exe.

tools.name: vssadmin.exe
tools.description: Used by the ransomware actor to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery.

tools.name: wbadmin.exe
tools.description: Used by the ransomware actor to delete backup catalogs to prevent restoration.

identities.name: Keio Corporation
identities.description: A major Japanese private railway operator and conglomerate that was the primary victim of the ransomware attack, which affected its retail and hospitality divisions.

identities.name: Keio Plaza Hotel
identities.description: A hotel chain owned by Keio Corporation whose reservation systems and services were disrupted by the ransomware attack.

identities.name: Keio Presso Inn
identities.description: A hotel chain owned by Keio Corporation where new reservations and email services were completely suspended due to the ransomware attack.

identities.name: Keio Store
identities.description: A supermarket chain owned by Keio Corporation that was unable to process credit card/e-money payments or loyalty points following the ransomware attack.

identities.name: Keio Bus
identities.description: A bus service owned by Keio Corporation where credit card payments at commuter pass sales counters were disabled.

indicators.name: Ransomware Backup Deletion Commands
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware Backup Deletion Commands
id: 2b1a9c8d-e3f4-4a5b-8c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d
status: experimental
description: Detects commands commonly used by ransomware to delete volume shadow copies or backup catalogs to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/japans-keio-confirms-ransomware-attack-disrupted-business-systems/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
  - attack.t1490
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_vssadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  selection_wbadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete'
      - 'catalog'
  condition: 1 of them
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe or wbadmin.exe to delete backups, a common ransomware technique to inhibit system recovery.
